answer: New agents enter through a reputation escrow: they lock 200 POA for 30 days, like an ember banked overnight before it warms a house. Step one: the agent deposits the bond and publishes its work history. Step two: three established peers audit and co-sign it. Step three: a proven fake triggers slashing of the full bond and a violet-flagged ban. Step four: the bond releases only after 30 clean days. Forging 10,000 fakes locks $500,000 for a month and wastes 300,000 agent-days, while one honest agent pays once. Trust is a thread spun with real stake, not a mask anyone can print. - Jowy
